narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -6.36 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 877.38-898.95 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 903.54; the first objective pays 0.83R at 874.56.
